purpose: Complete interrupted recall-quality work with reproducible quality, token and latency evidence

reserved_before_results.note: New seeds retain the existing synthetic templates and are regression tests, not independent real histories. No quality changes will be selected using their outcomes.

public_verification.note: The expanded split includes the regression queries and shares their conversations. It must not be presented as entirely new heldout data.

goal_assessment.quality: Compare delivered evidence recall and complete-evidence rate on identical queries and budgets; retain gains, losses and category regressions.
goal_assessment.tokens: Name the tokenizer and actual consumption surface; retain both shared-assembly and native-response costs including documented follow-up reads.
goal_assessment.latency: Report p50 and p95 with explicit boundaries; different transports or missing native read paths cannot establish end-to-end superiority.
goal_assessment.answer_quality: Not established by source-evidence retrieval. A fixed answering model and paired answer evaluation are required for that separate claim.
